{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjccM8AAAABZkr9jA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IfzhDLQq0", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3If", "number": 81, "title": "Correct V30MZ RET, RETF and IRET timing and destination alignment", "body": "## Problem

At baseline `6f939d2f4b275d6989a7740cdd82912cac158ea7`, `crates/ws-core/src/cpu.rs:666–673` assigns every RET/RETF form residual execution cost 4; lines 1074–1082 assign IRET 6. Neither includes loaded-destination parity. This undercharges ordinary returns and advances shared devices too little.

For aligned internal stacks and even destinations, current C3/CB/CF totals are 6/7/10 serialized clocks; corrected totals are 7/9/11. Existing CALL, indirect-control, trap and transfer tests preserve obsolete return expectations.

## Expected outcome

Correct C3 RET, C2 RET imm16, CB RETF, CA RETF imm16 and CF IRET, including necessary CPU, test, fixture-consumer and documentation changes. Preserve architectural return behavior and existing hardware acceptance. Full prefetch, effective-address hazards and unrelated bus policies remain separate gaps.

## Context

The clean checkout matches inspected remote `main`. The open collection, including PRs, is empty; all 80 closed-work titles were checked. [Issue #79](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/issues/79) and [PR #80](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/pull/80) explicitly deferred return timing.

The [NEC V30MZ manual](https://www.renesas.com/en/document/lbr/v30mztm-hardware-preliminary), Appendix A, printed pp. 73/81, gives decoded costs **6/6/8/9/10** for C3/C2/CB/CA/CF. Subtracting already charged aligned stack reads gives inferred residuals **5/5/6/7/7**. Add actual fetches, stack reads and waits once, plus one clock for an odd loaded IP. Applying the general branch-destination condition to returns is an explicit inference: each transfers execution to its restored CS:IP; Chapter 4 explains odd-target fetch alignment. The table assumes completed decoding, aligned words, no waits/holds and qualified addressing. These are serialized-accounting requirements, not complete pipeline measurements.

Correction record: replace the AI-authored preservation assumption of uniform RET/RETF residual 4, IRET 6 and no destination adjustment with the requirements above. Preserve architectural and regression acceptance. Record further evidence-based corrections with the old assumption, replacement, primary source and rationale; no human approval or independent AI re-review is required.

The inspected [WSTimingTest report](https://github.com/FluBBaOfWard/WSTimingTest/blob/025e606fc3b6615160ffdae485d992ffcad0c024/README.md) warns that aggregate timing includes pipeline/harness effects. Inspected ares return/prefetch implementations use different accounting; their constants are not transplantable requirements.

[Saved #79 evidence](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/blob/6f939d2f4b275d6989a7740cdd82912cac158ea7/docs/issue-79-validation.md) reports 276 workspace tests and complete production Chromium suites passing, with criterion-level review and negative controls. Tests are present; this investigation executed no application builds or tests. Published PR #80 reviews are empty. Commercial-title compatibility remains unestablished.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Record independent literal timing/state vectors before changing charges. Cover all five forms and opcode/stack/destination parity. At an even internal opcode address, aligned internal stack and even destination, require C3/C2/CB/CA/CF totals **7/9/9/12/11**; odd destinations add one. Odd opcode addresses reduce C2/CA totals by one through immediate-fetch consolidation. Expectations must not call production timing helpers.
- [ ] Assert exact CS/IP/SP, full FLAGS, other registers/segments, frame bytes and unrelated memory. Cover nonzero CS/SS, pop order, FLAGS normalization, immediate adjustments including zero/odd/wrapping values, SS selection despite overrides, instruction/stack offset wrapping and 20-bit/bank boundaries. Exercise real CALL→RET/RETF and interrupt→IRET continuation. Preserve existing IF shadows, TF activation/delivery and IRQ priority; account any subsequent entry separately.
- [ ] Cover internal RAM and mapped ROM/SRAM fetches and stack reads, live A0 `00/04/08/0C`, existing SRAM waits and model/mode RAM availability. Preserve transfer consolidation, mixed segment/BUSLOCK prefixes through seven prefixes and REP diagnostics. Exact access counts must reject duplicate transfers or destination pre-reads.
- [ ] Exercise emulated Mono/Color/SwanCrystal model configurations: Mono `00`; Color and SwanCrystal `00/80/C0/E0`, including live transitions back to `00`. Through normal `Machine::run_frame`, check representative returns crossing frame boundaries: exact elapsed clocks, raster/frame progression, timer decrement, stereo-sample production and no extra destination instruction. Preserve REP/HALT and separate GDMA/SDMA reservations with existing capability/mode gates.
- [ ] Add an original source-included CC0 return-timing cartridge using existing fixture tooling, with independent native and production Chromium consumers covering all five forms and even/odd destinations. Require absolute budgets, CPU-written execution/continuation counts, restored stack/frame/FLAGS checks, completion markers, supported mode passes, stale-save invalidation and two fresh boots. Document instruction/harness costs, retained approximations and timer quantization. Record old-charge failures for each form and a parity-only negative control in both consumers, then corrected passes with matching fixture identities; avoid fail-fast evidence that conceals untested forms.
- [ ] Recalculate affected existing intervals without widening tolerances or rewriting historical observations. For unchanged fixture bytes, calculated HBlank bounds are: direct CALL **480–481/496–497/608–609/624–625**; indirect CALL register **496–497/512–513**, near memory **544–545/560–561**, far memory **672–673/688–689**; IRQ even/odd stacks **252–253/276–277**. Direct returns add 1/2 clocks per near/far iteration; indirect returns to odd continuations add 2/3; IRQ IRET to `2005` adds 2. Independently confirm these sums. Preserve unaffected indirect JMP, direct JMP, Jcc/JCXZ, LOOP, ordinary-I/O and word-transfer bounds. Preserve external IRQ entry at 32/35 internal clocks and former-entry-charge rejection; its recalculated probe bounds are **192–193/216–217**. Retain discriminating prior CALL/indirect controls under the corrected return policy.
- [ ] Preserve startup/firmware policies, LCD/input/frame continuity, audio/PCM, DMA/Hyper Voice, SRAM, cartridge/internal EEPROM, RTC retention, browser save integrity, local data handling and ownership/provenance. Coordinator runs `python3 fixtures/build.py --check`, `python3 demo/build.py --check`, `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo test --workspace --locked`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`, and `git diff --check`. In `web`, run `npm run build:wasm`, `npm run build`, then complete `npm run test:browser` and `npm run test:compat` sequentially with `WS_PREVIEW_URL` targeting an explicit local production preview.
- [ ] Record tested source/artifact identities, independent calculations, actual results, failures, corrections and unperformed checks. Coordinator reviews the final diff and evidence against every criterion and resolves blocking findings before merge. All mandatory acceptance uses automated native/browser tooling.

## Optional validation

Additional lawful software experiments, another browser engine, physical-console measurements and human gameplay may supplement evidence. These were unperformed during planning and are not merge prerequisites. No proprietary ROM or firmware acquisition is required.

## Required post-merge verification

None.

## Specification reconciliation

This task was authored by AI under the agreed WonderSwan-family hardware goal.
Correct erroneous technical assumptions or acceptance criteria when primary hardware
specifications establish the correction. Update this Issue and record the original
assumption, corrected requirement, primary reference and rationale in the PR.
These technical corrections require neither human approval nor an independent AI
re-review. Preserve the agreed goal and relevant pre-merge acceptance; do not weaken
requirements merely to accommodate incomplete implementation or failing tests.

This autonomous campaign has no human-approval gate. Mandatory acceptance uses
automated native and production-browser tests on the emulator's supported model
and mode configurations. Physical-console measurements and human gameplay are
optional evidence and must remain explicitly unperformed unless actually available.
Do not invent device identities, real-device results or a requirement for human
confirmation. Resolve technical errors with recorded evidence and automated checks
through the existing Coordinator workflow.
